title: Move host lead policy into GLOBAL and install it by release
body:
Claude hooks, ~/.claude/skills/krn-*, the codex-worker wrapper and lead bin scripts are untracked host files with no review path; stale copies in ~/.agents/skills are visible to Codex; install-release.sh and lead.sh ship hand-roll steps that krn install and krn ship own; krn host-lock locks are per repository. Operator 2026-10-28: move this policy into GLOBAL.
Acceptance: the policy files live in GLOBAL, are exported and installed by a sealed release, stale copies are removed, the seal and install flow uses native krn install and krn ship, and host-lock serializes host-wide.

Operator clarification 2026-10-28: KRN skills must not be globally exposed to projects that do not adopt KRN; the universal mandate to delegate implementation is rejected. One explicitly requested Claude Opus5.5 audit (session279ac13e, report .krn/runs/claude/global-workflow-audit/opus-report.md) supports this direction. Existing ADR0010 amendment2026-10-14 already permits a lead to implement a clear accepted bounded change; independent review remains mandatory.
Additional acceptance: KRN lead procedures are project-local to Product/GLOBAL, reusable KRN workflow is visible only after repository adoption, and global Claude/Codex skill roots expose no KRN procedures. Disable/remove stale manual copies without touching historical project data or unrelated personal/vendor skills. Scope guard-codex-exec as well as other KRN hooks; outside adopting projects it must add no KRN context or command restriction. Hygiene must not block or demand mutations from read-only audit/worker sessions (observed Stop hook blocked Opus after its report). The native sealed installation must preserve these visibility/role boundaries and must not restore a global delegation mandate. Verify fresh adopting/non-adopting host contexts using private fixtures. User has already granted disabling global KRN skills; do not ask again for that same scope. No credentials, production or new hook trust is granted. Keep one final native seal/install; no install-release.sh.

Review advisory on GLOBAL #474 (third panel, spec): with setup-repository-workflow disabled in every global profile, a repository that has not adopted KRN yet has no discoverable path to the local setup procedure. Acceptance addition: a documented, tested way for a new repository to adopt KRN (for example invoking setup from the GLOBAL checkout or an explicit install step) that does not re-expose KRN procedures globally.
